mintAuthority.summary: VGBP has three independently mintable native deployments. Base and Celo use VNXCToken proxies whose chain-local VNXManager role-0 bearers can grant the minter role and set arbitrary per-minter allowances with no delay; 0xb65a...09c6 currently has a 1 billion VGBP allowance and all three roles on each chain, while 0xacc5...311a remains a role-0 bearer. Solana uses the classic SPL Token program with one unrestricted mint authority. No on-chain multisig, timelock, global supply cap, or disclosed MPC/HSM custody was found at the current cutoff. Bridge-only mechanics are not included in Mint Authority; the reviewed route inventory classifies all three deployments as native issuance.

controls.label: VGBP Base direct minter and role-0 bearer
controls.capDescription: Current raw allowance is 1e27, equal to 1 billion VGBP at 18 decimals; the same address can reset its allowance through role 0.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50066430 (hash 0xec072498b514dd35aa306df07eda42e6a1be97faa49e9edcac8f42f9ad8b08c3), this EOA held roles 0, 1, and 2 with a positive 1e27 raw allowance; read-only mint simulation returned true. One signature can mint within that allowance or use role 0 to configure an arbitrary replacement allowance. Token owner(), VNXManager owner(), and proxy-admin owner() were the same EOA. On-chain data does not establish whether the issuer uses MPC or HSM custody.

controls.label: VGBP Base VNXManager
controls.capDescription: Role 0 can grant role 2 and configure any per-minter allowance; no global supply cap was found.
bypassSurfaces: Role-0 bearers can grant themselves minter role 2 and set an arbitrary allowance immediately.
Role-0 bearers can transfer token ownership through VNXManager and replace the token RBAC address.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50066430 (hash 0xec072498b514dd35aa306df07eda42e6a1be97faa49e9edcac8f42f9ad8b08c3), role 0 bearers were 0xb65a7f02ce38efc0b6978c4167ed8f8d5d7209c6 and 0xacc56ebcc391108a725f269fdd82d6cbe65b311a; role 1 and role 2 bearer was 0xb65a...09c6. Role 0 administers all three roles, and the token, manager, and proxy-admin owner was 0xb65a...09c6.

controls.label: VGBP deployment-wide upgrade authorities
bypassSurfaces: On Base and Celo, proxy-admin owner 0xb65a...09c6 can use the inherited changeProxyAdmin path.
On Base and Celo, 0xb65a...09c6 is the current role-1 upgrade admin; either role-0 bearer can grant itself proxy-admin role 1 and call upgrade or upgradeAndCall with no delay.
The Solana Token program is immutable; its mint authority's rotation surface is represented by the Solana direct-minter control.
controls.evidence: The Base and Celo proxies each use chain-local VNXProxyAdmin 0xa5d680c17abcd0df3b9b4d5a7c7d1cae0051dcb4, owned by 0xb65a...09c6. Proxy-admin isUpgradeAdmin() is true for 0xb65a...09c6 with no delay; role 1 can upgrade, and role 0 administers role 1. Role-0 bearers are 0xb65a...09c6 and 0xacc5...311a on both chains; each is an EOA and either bearer can reach an upgrade path with no delay. Solana Tokenkeg ProgramData 3gvYRKWyXRR9xKWe1ZjPhLY5ZJRN7KDB4rFZFGoJfFk2 has null upgrade authority.

review.evidence: Current state was reconstructed from Base block 50066430 at 2026-08-16T23:16:47Z, Celo block 75021637 at 2026-08-16T23:19:55Z, and finalized Solana slot 439735891 at 2026-08-16T23:22:32Z. Base and Celo storage, role membership, token allowances, EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots, account ownership, and read-only mint simulations were checked; Solana mint metadata, supply, authority account, and post-slot mint transactions were checked. On both EVM deployments, 0xb65a...09c6 is token, manager, and proxy-admin owner, holds roles 0, 1, and 2, and has a 1e27 raw minter allowance; 0xacc5...311a remains role 0 only. The Solana mint remains controlled by 51b5...UksxaY. All three are independent native issuance paths, and their immediate mint or upgrade controls remain represented in Mint Authority with deploymentRefs; no bridge-only controller or route accounting is included here. EVM and Solana issuer keys are single-account controls on-chain, while off-chain MPC/HSM custody remains unknown. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No credible recurring current reconciliation was established for VGBP: AREVA General Auditing and Trust Company Limited issued a token-specific report only for 2024-12-31, published 2025-02-05, and VNX's current transparency page has no 2025 VGBP report. Liechtenstein FMA's exact VNX Commodities AG match is only a TT Service Provider registration, not prudential EMT-issuer supervision. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: immediate issuer-controlled mint and upgrade paths are unbounded; reconciliation remains unknown and supervision remains none. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: VNX's transparency inventory still has no later VGBP report and the 2026 operational wind-down does not reconcile the current Base, Celo, and Solana supply; reconciliation remains unknown.
